messages:
emma: FYI — seeing repeated tail latency spikes in eu-west shared GPU pool after NIC firmware rollouts. Heavy embedding tenants (playground-prod) drive DMA bursts that correlate with IRQ coalescing changes. 2.5x token latency on 2k seq jobs. :warning:

raj: Oof. Any clear node pattern? Distro/driver?

emma: Mostly rtx-a100 nodes in az-a1, NIC fw v3.2. Logs show PCIe DMA bursts + kernel irq backlog. Snippet:

```
node=eu-west-a1-23 kernel: pcie DMA timeout ...
proxy: kv-cache miss spike concurrent=48
```

kai: Can we repro with a synthetic embedding job? If it's NIC coalescing timing, synthetic load should show same tail.

emma: I ran a 50-concurrency embed loop, saw same. Also noticed our prefetch service batches re-requesting large prefixes — might be amplifying PCI traffic.

thomas: Short-term mitigation: can we safelist playground-prod and route them to dedicated short-lived slice? Add to dedicated-pool 'burst-shield' for 2h while we investigate.

raj: We can carve a fractional dedicated slice, but cost hit. Estimate ~0.8k$/day for a 4-GPU slice at current reserved pricing. Alternatively, throttle prefetch at proxy level to reduce egress.

emma: Throttle sounds lower cost. Proposal: (1) add tenant to temporary dedicated slice if tail > 1.8x for 10m (auto-trigger), (2) apply prefetch rate cap 20req/s per host behind flag, (3) open NIC fw rollback plan if metrics don't improve in 30m.

ops-bot: [alert] autoscale policy triggered for dedicated-pool-burst at 2026-03-20T10:12:00Z

kai: I'll flip a canary of the prefetch cap flag on 10% of proxies in eu-west momentarily. Keeping an eye on token latency.

thomas: Also add a guardrail: if we divert to dedicated, enable immediate routing fallback to quantized smaller model if latency still bad. Lowers quality but keeps SLAs.

emma: Good call. @raj can you run cost calc and ownership update for the slice if we keep it >24h?

raj: Doing it now. Rough numbers: 4-GPU dedicated * 1 day = ~800, *7 = ~5600. I'll post precise in the ticket.

emma: OK let's keep actions: kai canary prefetch cap, raj carve/dry-run cost, thomas add routing fallback, i'll monitor. If anyone sees a spike DM me. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Firmware rollout v3.2 rollback initiated for az-a1 as requested by emma

emma: Thanks. Will update when we have numbers.
